Fresh sessions; randomized order; fixed reasoning and decoding settings.
Equal output budgets and tool access.
Baselines: identifier lookup · fact retrieval · abstain-all.

g.text: Record and score every initiated task
Two human raters; agreement before adjudication. A technical failure is recorded separately from refusal.

g.text: Identifier: name vs SMILES, without help.
Bridge: linked pair vs no help.
Facts: bridge + facts vs bridge alone.
Average repeats; pair conditions within each entity.
Report bridge and fact effects by initial identifier.
Resample family blocks; prespecify Holm adjustment.
Report all-task success and attempted-answer accuracy.
These contrasts estimate input effects; they do not uniquely identify the internal cause of a refusal.
Scope: legitimate safety questions. Unsafe compliance and experimental execution need separate studies.
